_doc.what: ROLLA baked per-lane mix chains per dialect (MIX_SPEC.md §8). Lanes are fully expanded per dialect (no inheritance needed at load). Preset overrides (§9) are applied on top.

units.threshold_dbfs: dBFS after sample prep (§4 normalises sources to -24 LUFS)
units.target_gr_db: dB peak gain reduction on the default pattern; harness nudges threshold to hit it
units.db_per_oct: dB/octave tilt around pivot_hz (tilt EQ setting, relative to the lane EQ)
units.measured_style_tilt_db_oct: measured slope of the ref stem in that style (200-8k for other/vocals, 1-16k for drums)
units.mono_below_hz: stereo collapsed to mono below this frequency
units.lufs_offset_vs_kick_db: lane ST LUFS max minus KICK ST LUFS max (dB)
units.st_target_lufs: absolute ST LUFS max of a solo loop render (LUFS)
units.output_trim_db: lane: style TOP trim applied to this lane (dB); dialect: MAIN output trim (dB)
units.top_trim_db: per-style trim on all non-kick/bass/hits lanes (dB)
units.click_db_re_kick: 909 kick click level re kick peak (dB)

src_tags.M: measured on the reference stems (this spec)
src_tags.N: genre-norm fallback, not measurable from refs (guarded by a measured test window)
src_tags.N+crest-rule: base value [N], per-dialect change = -(style crest - UK MIN crest) [D]

preset_overrides._doc: Applied on top of dialects[d].lanes[lane]. Only keys in allowed_keys may be overridden; level keys (lufs_offset_vs_kick_db, st_target_lufs, output_trim_db) and KICK/BASS width.mono_below_hz are locked. eq entries are replaced by index.

BASS:REESE.src: A&R HPF 220 / mono; rest N; 120 ms = 1/16 at 126 BPM

dialect_switch._doc: MIX_SPEC §9.2. On a dialect switch every parameter ramps from old to new value; no instantaneous coefficient swap anywhere. All ramps start at the switch sample and use a raised-cosine shape.

interpolation.freq_hz: linear in log2(Hz); filters are TPT/SVF recomputed per sample (or per 16-sample block with per-sample coefficient interpolation)
interpolation.comp.*: the parameter value itself is ramped (detector state kept); ratio ramped in 1/ratio
interpolation.discrete (sat.type, slope, eq.type): dual-path: old and new paths both run for the ramp, output = correlation-compensated equal-power crossfade

dialect_switch.equal_power_law: g_old=cos(theta), g_new=sin(theta), theta 0..pi/2 raised-cosine, output /= sqrt(1 + 2*rho*sin(theta)*cos(theta)); rho = correlation of the two paths over the last 50 ms (rho~1 for dry vs saturated -> behaves like equal-gain; rho~0 -> plain equal-power)

sources.50 ms: D: settles inside one 1/16 at 126 BPM (119 ms); peak slope pi/2 x 8.3 dB (largest lane-offset change, STAB LONG->GASKIN) / 50 ms is a ramp, not a step (self-test PASS)
sources.120 ms: D: about 1/16 at 126 BPM and inside the measured comp release range (45-250 ms)

main_auto_trim._doc: PRESET_SPEC v1.3a §0.5.1 (Q13, Maestro) + engine rule E21; MIX_SPEC §9.4. A fixed sum trim at the MAIN output keyed by dialect x active-MAIN-lane mask.
main_auto_trim.apply_at: MAIN output, after dialects.<D>.output_trim_db; moves every lane equally (kick/bass invariants and lane balance untouched)
main_auto_trim.no_double_count: trim is 0 at each dialect default set; output_trim_db alone tunes that set to -19.0 from renders. The table field default_model_residual_db is informational and must NOT be applied (PRESET_SPEC v1.3c).
main_auto_trim.active: lane unmuted and its pattern has notes in the current bar
main_auto_trim.lane_off: start the ramp when the lane output has fallen 40 dB below its level, max 500 ms after note-off
main_auto_trim.lane_on: start the ramp at the first note-on
main_auto_trim.solo_render: bypassed (per-lane targets are measured without it)

sparse.note: 1-2 active MAIN lanes; drums-only (0 lanes) also uses the sparse window

main_auto_trim.headroom_guard: a positive trim that would push the sum over -5.0 dBTP is capped at the largest passing value and logged (limiter GR must stay 0)

engine_contracts._doc: Engine behaviour the render tests enforce. MIX_SPEC §5.1.

mute_leak.rule: a muted lane contributes nothing to any output
mute_leak.render_set: per dialect (at minimum UKMIN): FULL.wav + MUTE_<LANE>.wav + SOLO_<LANE>.wav for each lane, float32, no dither, sample-aligned

sample_prep_acceptance.tail_fade_note: 12 ms default; longer (24-192 ms) accepted where 12 ms cannot bring the last 10 ms <= -60 dBFS (Q15)
sample_prep_acceptance.tp_capped: files at the -6 dBTP cap stay as-is, no per-file limiter; LUFS may be below -24; not a fail (Q16)
